## Steps to reproduce

```lua
vim.o.swapfile = false
vim.o.shadafile = 'NONE'
local api = vim.api
local stub_cb_winclosed = function() pcall(api.nvim_win_close, 0, true) end
pcall(vim.cmd, 'tabnew')
pcall(api.nvim_create_autocmd, 'WinClosed', { ['callback'] = stub_cb_winclosed })
pcall(api.nvim_buf_delete, vim.api.nvim_list_bufs()[#vim.api.nvim_list_bufs() - 1], { ['force'] = true })
```
